name: Pair Cancel
description: Cancel a hostile soul note by pairing it with its mirror twin in the mind.

name: Mirror Sounding
description: Sound the mirror of a hostile soul tone and listen for the place where the two cancel.

name: Cloaked Calm
description: Cloak the soul in a calm that mirrors and dulls the force of whatever strikes it.

name: Mirror Mending
description: Hold up a mirror to the hurt in an ally's soul and cancel it with its calm reflection.

name: Reflected Quench
description: Quench a hostile soul force by reflecting its own shape back at it until it consumes itself.

name: Pair Unbinding
description: Unbind a soul affliction from an ally by laying its mirror twin over it until both fade.

name: Twin Hold
description: Hold a foe's soul technique between two opposing pulls until it can neither rise nor fall.

name: Mirrorpair Veil
description: Draw a veil of mirrored pairs round the user so that every hostile soul note meets its twin and ends.

name: Pair Rebuke
description: Rebuke a hostile soul strike by returning its mirror twin at the caster with the force reversed.

name: Grand Mirror
description: Raise a mirror of the whole field that cancels every hostile soul technique within it at once.

name: Quiet Pair
description: Set a quiet beside a hostile soul note and a second quiet beside its echo.

name: Hush Mapping
description: Map the quiet places in a soul clash to learn where a hostile technique is weakest.

name: Doubled Stillness
description: Hold stillness in two layers so that a hostile soul force must cross both to reach the mind.

name: Quiet Wave
description: Send out a wave of quiet that rolls over a hostile soul surge and smooths it flat.

name: Twin Absolve
description: Absolve an ally of a soul curse with two matching strokes of quiet laid one on the other.

name: Pair Stifle
description: Stifle a foe's soul strike and its echo together so that neither is heard.

name: Doubled Null
description: Cancel a hostile soul technique twice over so that no trace of its strike or echo remains.

name: Silent Bounce
description: Bounce a hostile soul note back along its own path in total silence so the caster is struck unheard.

name: Absolute Pair
description: Hold the twin quiet over an entire company so that every hostile soul force aimed at it is cancelled.

name: Perfect Hover
description: Hover in perfect stillness above a clash of souls so that none of it touches the user.

name: High Null
description: Cancel a hostile soul note from a height with a single falling thread of quiet.

name: Keen Sensing
description: Scan the field from above with a keen quiet sense and mark each rising soul technique.

name: Gentle Perch
description: Set the shaken soul of an ally on a gentle perch of calm until its tremors cease.

name: Dive Hush
description: Dive on a foe's soul with a hush that presses the force out of their next technique.

name: Descending Null
description: Descend on a hostile soul technique from above and cancel it before it has gathered strength.

name: Talon Unbinding
description: Cut a soul binding from an ally with the clean cancelling grip of a talon.

name: Wing Stifle
description: Spread a wing of quiet over foes that stifles the rise of their soul techniques.

name: Perfect Stillness
description: Settle into a stillness so perfect that hostile soul force finds nothing to push against.

name: Raptor Rebuke
description: Stoop on a hostile soul strike and carry it back to the one who sent it.

name: Zenith Stillness
description: Rise to the zenith of stillness and cancel every hostile soul technique that dares to climb.

name: Silent Track
description: Run a silent track beside a hostile soul note and cancel it as it passes.

name: Hushed Survey
description: Survey the field in a hush and mark every soul technique that is gathering its force.

name: Parallel Guard
description: Keep two guards running in parallel so that a break in one is held by the other.

name: Twin Silence
description: Lay twin silences over a hostile soul wave and its aftershock so both fall away.

name: Silence Unbinding
description: Unbind a soul curse from an ally by laying a silence along each of its two tracks.

name: Seam Rip
description: Rip along the seam between a foe's two soul tracks so that the technique splits and fails.

name: Dual Silence
description: Hold two silences on two tracks at once so that a hostile technique is cancelled in form and echo.

name: Silence Return
description: Return a hostile soul strike down the second track in silence so that it lands on its sender.

name: Absolute Silence
description: Let absolute silence fall on the whole field so that no hostile soul technique can sound.

name: Gust Quench
description: Quench a hostile soul note with a gust of quiet that blows it out like a flame.

name: Breeze Tell
description: Let a light breeze of quiet carry back the signs of any hostile soul force nearby.

name: Sworn Calm
description: Hold to the sworn calm so that no hostile soul force can stir the mind.

name: Gentle Gust
description: Pass a gentle gust of calm over an ally's soul until the sore places are smoothed.

name: Gale Quench
description: Send a gale of cancelling force through a hostile soul surge and scatter it to nothing.

name: Sworn Absolving
description: Speak the sworn absolving over a comrade and let a hostile taint blow out of their soul.

name: Wind Stifle
description: Blow a still wind over foes that smothers the rise of their soul techniques.

name: Quiet Oath
description: Swear the quiet oath aloud in the open and hold it until hostile soul force fades.

name: Gale Answer
description: Rebuke a hostile soul strike with a gale that carries it back to its sender.

name: Sovereign Hush
description: Cast a sovereign hush over the open field so that every hostile soul technique within it dies unheard.

name: Vow Cancel
description: Cancel a hostile soul note with a vow of quiet spoken beneath the breath.

name: Vow Sounding
description: Read how firmly each comrade holds the vow of quiet and which of them wavers.

name: Vow Stillness
description: Stand guard on the vow so that a hostile soul push finds the mind closed and still.

name: Vow Healing
description: Speak the vow of quiet over an ally until the hurt in their soul is cancelled.

name: Vow Dull
description: Dull the edge of a foe's soul technique with a quiet vow breathed at its first beat.

name: Vow Quench
description: Hold the vow against a spreading hostile soul force until the last of it is quenched.

name: Vow Loosening
description: Speak the release of the vow over a comrade and cancel the hostile hold upon their soul.

name: Vow Stifle
description: Stifle a foe's rising soul technique under the weight of the vow of quiet.

name: Chained Null
description: Cancel hostile soul notes one after another in the order they arrive without a gap between.

name: Unbroken Vow
description: Hold the vow of quiet unbroken through a long barrage until the barrage has spent itself.

name: Vow Rebound
description: Rebound a hostile soul strike off the vow so that it returns upon the one who sent it.

name: Vow Absolute
description: Swear the absolute vow over a company so that no hostile soul technique can touch any of it.

name: Bearing Cancel
description: Take the bearing of a hostile soul note and cancel it along the same line.

name: Heading Tell
description: Tell the heading of a hostile soul force by the lean of its first pulse.

name: Steady Course
description: Hold the soul to a steady course so that hostile force cannot push it off its line.

name: Heading Quench
description: Quench a hostile soul force by setting its own heading against it until it dies.

name: Bearing Absolve
description: Absolve an ally of a curse that has bent the bearing of their soul and set it true.

name: Course Stifle
description: Stifle the course of a foe's soul technique so that it cannot find its mark.

name: Faithful Heading
description: Hold a true heading against all hostile soul force until each blow has run itself out.

name: Turned Bearing
description: Turn the bearing of a hostile soul strike back on its sender at the last moment.

name: Settled Bearing
description: Fix a bearing for the whole company so that every hostile soul force aimed at it is turned dead.

name: Open Quench
description: Stand open to a hostile soul note and quench it in plain view with its opposite.

name: Broad Listening
description: Listen widely across the open field and mark every hostile soul force that stirs.

name: Bare Calm
description: Stand in a bare calm with no cover and let hostile force find nothing to strike.

name: Open Easing
description: Ease an ally's soul in the open with a plain calm that cancels each of its tremors.

name: Bare Dull
description: Dull a foe's soul technique with a plain bare pulse that robs it of its edge.

name: Open Stillness
description: Spread an open stillness before the user that cancels each hostile soul note it meets.

name: Open Absolve
description: Absolve a comrade of a soul affliction in the open by laying a plain stillness upon it.

name: Open Stifle
description: Stifle the soul technique of a foe in plain view with a calm that gives it no hold.

name: Calming Veil
description: Extend the open stillness over nearby allies so that hostile soul notes aimed at them are cancelled.

name: Stillness Without Edge
description: Spread a stillness with no edge so that hostile soul force never finds the limit it could press on.

name: Open Rebound
description: Rebound a hostile soul strike in plain view so that it turns and returns upon its sender.

name: Boundless Quiet
description: Let the quiet spread without bound across the field until every hostile soul note within it is cancelled.

name: Sovereign Stillness
description: Rule the field with a sovereign quiet that cancels every hostile soul force within its reach.
